page_title: PeaZip free archiver utility, open extract RAR TAR ZIP files

summary.name: PeaZip
summary.one_liner: PeaZip is a free, open source, cross-platform file archiver utility for opening, extracting and creating archives in 200+ formats, including RAR, TAR and ZIP.
use_cases: extract RAR, ZIP and TAR archives
compress and encrypt files with a password plus keyfile
automate archiving or backups via exported CLI scripts
run a portable archiver from a USB drive without installation
summary.what_it_does: PeaZip provides a graphical archive manager that opens and extracts 200+ archive formats, including RAR, TAR and ZIP. It can create archives in less common formats such as zpaq, brotli and zstandard, and offers a GUI for 7z/p7zip on non-Windows systems. Encryption supports two-factor authentication using a password plus a keyfile. Extra tools include checksum and hash verification, finding duplicates, converting archives, and searching inside archives. The Console tab exports GUI tasks as CLI scripts for reuse or automation. The program is natively portable and can run from removable devices without installation.
notable: Two factor encryption using password plus keyfile
Console tab exports GUI tasks as CLI scripts
Natively portable, runs from removable drives without install
caveats: Packages are not code-signed; the page recommends checking SHA256 hashes against the official SHA256.txt
Websites and Microsoft Store publishers listing alleged PeaZip packages are not affiliated with the project
